newsitem.title: USA: U.S. exporters report corn sold to Egypt - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. exporters report corn sold to Egypt - USDA.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said Wednesday private exporters reported sales of 500,000 tonnes of corn to Egypt.
USDA said that of the total, 450,000 tonnes are for delivery during the 1996/97 marketing year, with 50,000 tonnes for delivery in the 1997/98 marketing year.
The marketing year for corn begins Sept 1.
USDA said the sales will be included in the export sales report for the week ending Oct 10, which will be released Friday.

USDA issues daily and weekly export sales reports. Exporters must report to USDA sales of 100,000 tonnes or more of one commodity made in one day to a single destination by 1500 ET the next business day after the sale.
Sales of lesser quantities must be reported weekly.
